name: OpenHands
summary: Self-hosted developer control center for coding agents and automations — OpenHands, Claude Code, Codex and more.
description: Agent Canvas turns coding agents into an always-on engineering team: start conversations, switch between local, Docker, remote and cloud agent backends, and build scheduled or webhook automations that integrate with Slack, GitHub and Linear. Runs the open-source OpenHands agent out of the box, or Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Pi, OpenCode and any ACP-compatible agent.
